envelope.derivation: Union of the river crop (east -1500..+950 m, north -1600..+800 m from the crane origin) and SMHI Vinga A (57.6322 N, 11.6048 E; about east -18179, north -7195 m), expanded by 2 km in EPSG:3007, converted to a longitude/latitude box. Recomputation with pyproj 3.8.0 agrees within about 0.5 m on the west/south edges.
envelope.status: Initial source envelope, not a playable boundary; A0.3 may expand it.
